question: The Hemis Gompa festival is celebrated to celebrate the birth anniversary of Guru _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padmasambhava**__.

__
 
• **The **Hemis Gompa festival is celebrated to celebrate the birth anniversary of Guru Padmasambhava__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hemis festival** of **Ladakh **is celebrated to **mark the birth anniversary of Guru Padmasambhava**.
 
• It is a **two-day celebration** that marks the victory of good over evil.
 
• The legend has it that** Lord Padamsambhav defeated the dark forces** with the help of Vajrayana Buddhism.
 
• The **masked dance** performance called **Cham** makes the festival more attractive.
 
• It is a slow dance and depicts the war between good and evil wherein the good wins.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Katyayana:**

 
 
• He was a disciple of Gautama Buddha.
 
• He is listed as one of the ten principal disciples.
 
• He is also known as Phra Sangkajai.
 
 
 
• **Patrul Rinpoche:**
 
 
• ​He was a teacher and author from the Nyingma school of Tibetan Buddhism.
 
• Some of his teachings are:
 
 
• Use the time of your life.
 
• Develop your inner happiness.
 
• Recognize the impermanence of all outer pleasure.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Marpa Lotsawa:**
 
 
• He ​was a Tibetan Buddhist teacher credited with the transmission of many Vajrayana teachings from India.
 
• He is said to have founded Stongdey Monastery in Zanskar in 1052 CE.
